newsitem.title: FRANCE: Citroen Europe vehicle sales up 9.5 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Citroen Europe vehicle sales up 9.5 pct in 1996.

text.p: PARIS, Dec 11 (Reuer) - Citroen Automobiles, a branch of PSA Peugeot Citroen, said it expected registrations of cars and commercial vehicles in western Europe this year to increase by 9.51 percent to 755,275 from 689,687 in 1995.
It said in a statement it expected car registrations in western Europe to increase by 8.68 percent to 632,654.
In western Europe excluding France, car and commercial vehicle registrations are expected to rise 10.78 percent to 428,205 and car registrations are expected to rise 8.77 percent to 371,054.
Car sales in France are expected to rise 8.55 percent to 261,600 for a market share of 12.40 percent, down from 12.48 percent last year.
